assertions.name: multiterm_cost_cannot_rescue_6_2
assertions.source: 6_2 cost floor 0.89 > winner max 0.25, independent of binding formula

description: Refutes the audit hypothesis that wiring T2-T6 into the SDP cost makes deuteron 6_2 the winner. The cost is alpha_gap + 0.25·rel_resid; multi-term only affects rel_resid (secondary). 6_2's alpha_gap=0.89 (intrinsic PSD-infeasibility) floors its cost at 0.89 >> winner's max 0.25 — for ANY binding formula. The deuteron SDP blocker is 6_2 PSD-infeasibility, not the cost.
